role: Bootstrap sequence for Co-Being knowledge graph—one-time idempotent initialization to operational state.
detail: Implements bootstrap_graph() async function that creates exactly 4 EvolutionRule META_SCHEMA nodes (TYPE_CREATION_THRESHOLD=3, GUARDIAN_NAME_TRIGGERS_TYPE, PREDICTION_ERROR_DEMOTION with demotion_threshold=0.25/min_confidence_floor=0.10/demotion_factor=0.15/cooldown_observations=3, RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD=0.50) and 1 CoBeing SCHEMA self-identity node. Most rules use INFERENCE provenance (source_id='bootstrap', confidence=1.0); RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD uses GUARDIAN_APPROVED_INFERENCE as tunable policy parameter. Includes idempotency check via get_node() before save_node(), post-bootstrap validation by specific node IDs, and Phase 3 call to bootstrap_primitives() for conversation engine. Also exports get_evolution_rule_value() utility to read current_value from any EvolutionRule by name. Raises BootstrapError on creation failure or validation failure.
gotchas: Post-bootstrap validation comment (line 368) notes that counting by schema-level would fail once procedural ontology bootstrap adds ConceptPrimitive (SCHEMA) and additional META_SCHEMA nodes—validation deliberately uses specific node IDs instead. RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD is the only rule with GUARDIAN_APPROVED_INFERENCE; all others default to INFERENCE. get_evolution_rule_value() returns None (not error) if rule missing or has no current_value.
